answer: A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, since the declared depth is recorded in the yarrow receipt and checked against the gale nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 193 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. Since the nebula audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded.
